messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Take B_n(x) = x^n, x ∈ [0,1]. Pointwise limit: f(x) = 0, x < 1; f(1) = 1. f discontinuous at 1. Uniform convergence of polynomials on compact intervals forces continuity of limit (Weierstrass). B_n fails uniform convergence. Verify: sup |x^n − f(x)| ≥ 1/2 ∀n, contradicting uniformity.
